thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for gpu-memory-pressure (svc:inference) — count: 23 recent failures, severity: P1. page_key=PD-9143 link=https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-9143

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-9143 created by monitoring (auto). Status: triggered. Acknowledgements: 0. Escalation policy: oncall-sre-primary.

alex_oncall: acked. I’m on it. :eyes:

sam_ops: seeing OOM-ish traces on a couple nodes in gpu-pool-west-2a-highmem. grabbing logs now.

sam_ops: log snippet from node gpu-03:```
[  123.456789] NVRM: GPU 0: Out of memory when allocating 134217728 bytes
[  123.456792] cuda: kernelpanic: failed to allocate tensor slab, ret=-12
[  123.456800] inference-pod/model-server-7f9d4 OOMKilled
```

alex_oncall: thanks. Is this multi-tenant or isolated to one model?

sam_ops: looks like multi-tenant. I’m seeing the same model-serving:v1.4 pods across 4 nodes crash around the same time. Prefetch/warmup jobs kicked off ~5m before spikes.

irina_sre: possible slab fragmentation after concurrent warmup + KV cache prefetch. We recently bumped prefetch concurrency in the autoscaler config on that pool.

alex_oncall: good catch. Can we confirm config change?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: autoscaler-config updated by infra-ci at 2026-03-15T02:38Z — change: prefetch_concurrency 8 -> 16 — rollout id: r-20260315-03

sam_ops: that matches timestamp. I’m rolling a quick revert on the autoscaler to reduce concurrency to 8. Will patch config and restart autoscaler controller.

alex_oncall: meanwhile we should reduce load on that pool. Sam, can you enable model routing fallback for model-serving:v1.4 to model-serving:v1.3 in west-2 for 10m? Route policy: prefer-capacity then fallback.

sam_ops: doing that now. command:```bash
redwoodctl route update --from model-serving:v1.4 --to model-serving:v1.3 --region west-2 --policy fallback --duration 10m
```

sam_ops: route applied. Traffic % to v1.3 increased to 40%.

jamie_cs: Customer impact check: two paying customers reported increased errors — acct:acme-corp and acct:playhouse. Acme sees ~15% 5xx on text-generation, Playhouse ~8%. I'm opening a customer incident and looping in account folks.

alex_oncall: thanks Jamie. Please send them the temporary mitigation note and ETA for fix.

jamie_cs: on it. template: "We're seeing transient GPU memory pressure affecting text-generation for a subset of requests; our engineers have applied routing fallbacks and are reverting a recent prefetch config change. Full mitigation ETA ~15-30m."

irina_sre: after the revert, I'm going to trigger a rolling restart of the worst nodes to clear slab fragmentation. Sam, can you cordon+drain gpu-03 and gpu-04 sequentially?

sam_ops: cordoning gpu-03 now. drain in progress:```bash
kubectl drain gpu-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference```

sam_ops: drain finished, pods rescheduled to other healthy nodes. restarting autoscaler controller with previous config.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-9143 acknowledged by alex_oncall.

sam_ops: verifying memory usage on shifted nodes — memory stabilized, no new OOMs in the last 4 minutes. KV cache hit rate temporarily dropped as expected, but latency within SLO.

alex_oncall: good. keep monitoring for 20 more minutes. Sam, please capture the sequence of events and commands you ran so infra can audit.

sam_ops: copied below:```
# actions taken
1) reroute traffic to model-serving:v1.3 (40%)
2) revert autoscaler prefetch_concurrency 16 -> 8 and restart controller
3) cordon+drain gpu-03, gpu-04 sequentially
4) monitor metrics and OOM logs
```

irina_sre: next steps if OOMs return: scale up pool by +2 gpus, enable per-tenant prefetch limits, and add eviction heuristics to kill warmup jobs when free mem < 15%.

alex_oncall: agree. Sam, can you file an infra ticket with logs + timeline and assign to infra-gpu team? Tag with PD-9143.

sam_ops: ticket created: INFRA-1489 link=https://tracker.example/INFRA-1489 (includes node logs, autoscaler diff, route changes).

jamie_cs: customers notified with mitigation message. Both customers acknowledged. We'll do a follow-up summary postmortem.

alex_oncall: handing off to irina_sre for the rest of the oncall shift. Summary: PD-9143 triggered by elevated prefetch_concurrency causing GPU slab fragmentation + OOM during concurrent warmup; temporary mitigation: routing fallback + revert + node drains; monitoring stable. Please resolve PD when fully stable and attach postmortem.

irina_sre: taking over. I'll keep PD open until 30m with no recurrences. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-9143 status updated: acknowledged by alex_oncall, assigned to oncall-sre-primary.

alex_oncall: FYI I'll add a short runbook note in the infra repo about safe prefetch concurrency bounds for highmem pools.

irina_sre: noted. Also adding an alert tweak: suppress duplicate auto-pages for the same node group for 5m to reduce noisy pages during mitigation.

sam_ops: +1 on suppression. Will include that in INFRA-1489.

incident-bot: PD-9143 will auto-escalate if not acknowledged in 10m (but it's acknowledged).

irina_sre: final check: metrics show API 5xx for acme down from 15% -> 2% after reroute. Playhouse down to 1%. Leaving routing at 25% fallback for 10 more minutes.

alex_oncall: great. handing off completely. irina, escalate to infra-gpu if any reoccurrence.

irina_sre: will do. closing handoff.

(END THREAD)
